OpenOraclePriceCoordinator

Per-question adapter to its security pool’s shared REP-per-collateral feed for one universe. It exposes reporting and canonical price reads without staging capital operations. OpenOraclePriceCoordinator source contract

Read surface

priceFeed and sharedPriceFeed identify the shared universe feed. It owns accepted price, freshness and report candidates. lastSettlementTimestamp records settlement eligibility, not delayed execution time. isPriceValid checks the accepted price and canonical priceValidUntil; pending or rejected reports do not extend expiry. pendingReportId and pendingReportSponsor identify the latest candidate, without blocking independent candidates. Reports use separate escrows. reportDelegate implements authenticated shared report creation. questionLedger is bound once by the coordinator factory. Capital operations may execute directly against an accepted price or as a sponsor-bound batch submitted through the shared feed. Additional validated getters: lastPrice, pendingReportMaxSettlementBaseFeeAttoEthPerGas, minimumToken1ReportAttoEth, getRequestPriceCostAttoEth, getSettlementCallbackGasLimit, reputationToken, openOracle, collateralToken, weth, initialReportPriorityFeeAttoEthPerGas, targetPriceErrorForDispute, settlementTime, disputeDelay, protocolFee, feePercentage, multiplier, protocolFeeRecipient, escalationHaltMultiplierBps, maxSettlementBaseFeeMultiplierBps, minLiquidationPriceDistanceBps.

Security assumptions

Report liveness depends on A16 timely inclusion, A17 corrector capability, A18 independent correction incentive, A19 observable correctable price, and A06 lifecycle executors. When lastPrice is zero, the official client currently needs an offchain market quote to propose the first report; quote availability is a client limitation rather than a protocol security assumption. Proposals copied from a nonzero cached price do not use that quote path.

State-changing interactions

Each call lists its parameter names in ABI order. The contract index defines the columns.

Transaction Caller Main prerequisites State or asset effect Primary signals
requestPrice(proposedRepPerEthPrice, requestedInitialAttoWeth, bountyAttoEth) with report funding Anyone; shared candidates may coexist and renew before the accepted price expires Supply a nonzero raw REP-per-collateral price scaled by 1e18 and a bounty covering the shared feed’s gas-based minimum, funded by msg.value. Approve the exact requested collateral and the matching REP for that price. The request reverts if the shared feed’s minimumToken1ReportAttoEthForPrice exceeds the requested collateral. The creator-configured floor and current exposure set the minimum, independent of dispute gas costs. Funding is isolated in a new report escrow. The caller must accept any excess-ETH refund. Opens and atomically funds a fresh REP-per-collateral report without staging a new operation, retains the whole committed bounty as the settler reward, then refunds any ETH above the bounty through a low-level caller callback. Callback rejection rolls back the report and initial position. PriceRequested and ReportFundingAssigned from the shared feed.
recoverSettledPendingReport() Anyone A pending report ID exists and its stored OpenOracle storedGame(reportId).settlementTimestamp is nonzero. Retries acceptance of the feed’s latest settled candidate from OpenOracle’s stored amounts and original settlement-eligibility timestamp, after a failed callback or a settlement block above the report’s base-fee cap. Use feed.recoverReport(reportId) for another unprocessed settled candidate. A valid candidate accepts its price and attempts sponsor operations. An economically insufficient or older candidate can instead attempt its signed operations under a fresh canonical price without granting report authority. Both paths require the current base fee to be at or below the candidate cap (Base fee too high); the canonical-operation path may remain available after the candidate itself expires. Other invalid candidates are rejected. Already-released funding remains available through the report escrow’s separate withdrawal methods. PendingReportRecovered from the shared feed.
setSharedPriceFeed(feed) Deployment worker only No prior shared feed or ledger; nonzero feed with matching REP, configured WETH wrapper, and OpenOracle. Binds the shared report source once, before the question ledger is assigned. SharedPriceFeedSet
syncExposure() Anyone; question ledger accounting checkpoints also invoke it A shared coordinator must already be registered by its canonical factory. Reads the live security pool aggregate, max(standing commitments, branch-auction commitment, funded demand), and emits a checkpoint if it changed. Question finality does not independently clear this shared exposure. Feed ExposureCheckpoint when the security pool aggregate changes
setQuestionLedger(questionLedger) The coordinator’s deployer only; production binding passes through the authenticated factory and deployment-worker chain Current questionLedger is zero (Question ledger already set); the argument itself is not required to be nonzero. A nonzero value binds the question ledger permanently. A zero value emits QuestionLedgerSet with zero but leaves the setter callable by its deployer. SecurityPoolFactory supplies the nonzero canonical question ledger immediately after deploying the question ledger. A prepared coordinator cannot be claimed by another caller between transactions.
